units: points, origin at the top left of the page, y downwards

lines.text: Case A: typed label, hanging indent 50 pt, no custom tab stops. The text after the tab
shows where the tab ended, and the wrapped second line shows where the hanging
indent puts the text of the following lines.
Case B: list label, level indent left 50 pt, hanging 50 pt, tab suffix. The text after the tab
shows where the tab ended, and the wrapped second line shows where the hanging
indent puts the text of the following lines.
Clause 12.3.4 Case C: typed label wider than the 50 pt hanging indent. The text after the tab shows
where the tab ended, and the wrapped second line shows where the hanging indent puts
the text of the following lines.
Case D: typed label, hanging indent 50 pt, custom tab stop at 75 pt. The text after the tab
shows where the tab ended, and the wrapped second line shows where the hanging
indent puts the text of the following lines.
Case E: typed label, first-line indent 25 pt, no hanging indent. The text after the tab
shows where the tab ended, and the wrapped second line shows where the hanging indent puts the
text of the following lines.
Case F: typed label, left indent 100 pt, hanging 50 pt. The text after the tab
shows where the tab ended, and the wrapped second line shows where the
hanging indent puts the text of the following lines.
Case G: list label with a level tab stop of type num at 72 pt. The text after the tab shows
where the tab ended, and the wrapped second line shows where the hanging indent puts
the text of the following lines.
1. Case H: list label with a space suffix. The text after the tab shows where the tab ended, and the
wrapped second line shows where the hanging indent puts the text of the following lines.
Paragraph 1: Case I: list label wider than the 50 pt hanging indent. The text after the tab shows
where the tab ended, and the wrapped second line shows where the hanging indent puts
the text of the following lines.
